identificationModule.briefTitle: AVAPERL1 Study: A Study of Avastin (Bevacizumab) With or Without Pemetrexed as Maintenance Therapy After Avastin in First Line in Patients With Non-Squamous Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: Open-label Study of Bevacizumab Maintenance Therapy (AVASTIN®) With or Without Pemetrexed After First-line Chemotherapy With Bevacizumab-cisplatin-pemetrexed in Patients With Advanced, Metastatic or Recurrent Non-squamous Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

interventions.name: bevacizumab [Avastin]
interventions.description: 7.5mg/kg iv on day 1 of each 3-week cycle

interventions.name: cisplatin
interventions.description: 75mg/m2 iv on day 1 of each 3-week cycle

interventions.name: pemetrexed
interventions.description: 500mg/m2 iv on day 1 of each 3-week cycle
